method: Palette mapping and majority vote in calibrated sheet grid; no interpolating resize, row deletion or limb assembly. Only approved head mask is pasted. Generated sheet resolution differs from reference; lattice follows complete sheet extents.
known_limitations: Running sprites are larger than approved 42-row scale; leg alternation and fixed head horizontal position not satisfied.
Standing legs differ from approved design; no prohibited body-part assembly was used to conceal the difference.
Generated head removal can leave residual crest/outline pixels beside pasted mask.
Canvas-based majority lattice is approximate because generated files did not preserve requested dimensions or native grid. It can merge small generated details.
Whole frame offsets correct soles but do not prove exact pose/hip alignment with provided pivots.
Some blade edge and beard details differ from approved pixel shapes.
